title: BBCCFBJBJB
about: A personal look back at my State Arts-In romance with Alyssa during Ballroom Year, from the quiet moments that brought us together to the final days when we drifted apart.
body: BBCCFBJBJB tells the story of my relationship with Alyssa during Ballroom Year, one of those relationships we came to call a State Arts-In romance.

It started quietly. We kept finding each other while walking around the fair, holding hands turned into interlocked fingers, and moments that almost nobody else noticed slowly became a relationship. Hidden walks, the garden where I finally asked her out, caffeine arguments, random growls, and time stolen away from everything happening around us became some of my strongest memories from that year.

The album also follows the less happy part of that story. Behind the grandstand, small misunderstandings started appearing, and during the final four days of the fair the closeness between us seemed to disappear until all that remained was one last conversation.
